# CNA C API Coverage Summary

<!-- Generated by tools/c-api/generate_coverage_inventory.py; do not edit by hand. -->

## Coverage contract

The mandatory coverage gate derives the complete public C++ declaration inventory from
`modules/*/include/{Microsoft,CNA}/**/*.hpp` and maps every symbol through
`tools/c-api/coverage_mappings.json`. Every module is classified as runtime C API scope or
out of it by `MODULE_SCOPE`, which is a total function over the modules that exist: a new
or renamed module stops this gate rather than inheriting a default. Paths whose segments
are `Internal` or `Detail` in any capitalization are excluded as implementation detail.
No symbol counts as implemented merely because a related C operation exists.

Snapshot: **556 headers**, **9355 symbols**, **8363 implemented**, **15 partial**, **468 planned**, **509 not applicable**. Explicitly excluded headers: **287**.

The complete per-symbol Markdown is generated on demand into the ignored build tree so
that a multi-megabyte derived file is not recommitted whenever one public declaration moves:

```bash
python3 tools/c-api/generate_coverage_inventory.py --write
# full matrix: build/c-api/COVERAGE_FULL.md
python3 tools/c-api/generate_coverage_inventory.py --check
```

`--check` rebuilds the full inventory in memory, validates every mapping and planned-row
owner, hashes the complete matrix, and compares this summary. The CTest
`CApiCoverageMatrix` and `.github/workflows/c-api-coverage-gate.yml` run it.

## Status definitions

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| implemented | Exact current C mapping and C-only evidence are named. |
| partial | An approved specialization/subset exists and its boundary is recorded. |
| planned | No complete C mapping exists; an unfinished task owns the work. |
| not applicable | The declaration has no callable C++ behavior or belongs to a declared substrate boundary. |
